Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614421. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, filter by assay_id from assays where chembl_id equals CHEMBL1614421, filter standard_value not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
